name: v0.1.4
body:
## Annona v0.1.4

**Beta.** On macOS, if these builds are not notarised, the right-click → **Open**
trick no longer exists: since macOS 15 an un-notarised app that carries a quarantine
flag is reported as damaged and **moved to the Trash**. Clear the flag on the disk
image before opening it:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Downloads/Annona_*.dmg
```

On Windows, SmartScreen may warn; click **More info** then **Run anyway**.

### Downloads
- **macOS Apple Silicon (M-series)**: `Annona_*_aarch64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel**: `Annona_*_x64.dmg`
- **Windows**: `Annona_*_x64-setup.exe`
- **Linux**: `Annona_*_amd64.AppImage` or `annona_*_amd64.deb`

See [QUICKSTART.md](../QUICKSTART.md) for usage.


## What's Changed
* fix(ci): declare numpy, and stop requiring 3.11 in a test by @Harshatalluru in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/29
* docs(placement): say that on_unavailable: queue is not resumed (refs #3) by @Harshatalluru in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/34
* fix(attachments): a follow-up can reach a file attached earlier (#16) by @Harshatalluru in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/32
* refactor(tools): tools declare typed arguments; the base stops lying (#8) by @Harshatalluru in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/33
* fix(perimeter): a fresh install is fail-closed, a legacy one says so (#2) by @Harshatalluru in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/30
* fix(brain): rebuild the vault index from the notes, the file wins (#6) by @Harshatalluru in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/31
* fix(redaction): redact the material, keep the conversation's shape (#40) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/44
* fix(log): the step's text stays out of annona.log (#37) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/45
* fix(ledger): payload digests are keyed, so the file cannot test a guess (#39) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/46
* fix(cli): a held step is not completed, and exits 3 (#38) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/47
* fix: retire install.sh, install-remote.sh and uninstall.sh (#41) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/48
* fix(cli): doctor and status change nothing on an empty home (#42) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/49
* fix: the version is written once, and the banner, CLI and API read it (#43) by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/50
* chore: delete AIClient.execute_command, a path that shipped os.environ by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/51
* feat: run on a DGX Spark and a Ryzen AI Max box, and say so when the GPU is idle by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/52
* feat(link): an acceptance run for Studio → machine, and held jobs are not "completed" by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/53
* docs(readme): diagrams for both themes, the refusal typed out, Studio in pictures by @M-ballabio1 in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/56

## New Contributors
* @Harshatalluru made their first contribution in https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/pull/29

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/akaion-ai/annona/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4
